label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is concatenated into URI at sink ('http://' + host). The InetAddress.getAllByName() call validates against site/local/link local addresses, but this does not prevent SSRF to external/internal hosts, metadata endpoints, or other targets. Resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled user input.

evidence.note: User param -> host variable -> URI sink at L27 with no effective SSRF prevention
